title: tab/contextMenu
description: Engine-to-shell notification: the person asked for the page's context menu (a right click, the menu key). The engine cancels Chromium's own menu (CefContextMenuHandler::RunContextMenu) and sends what was under the pointer; the shell shows its Visual Studio-style menu (Back, Forward, Reload, Copy, Paste, Select All, Save Image As..., Copy Link, Open in External Browser, Inspect) and runs the item through the commands and tab/action.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

x.description: Where, in CSS pixels of the view.

imageUrl.description: The image under the pointer (its source url).

editable.description: The pointer is over an editable field.

edit.description: Which edit commands apply (CEF's edit state flags).
